summary: Frontend-only E2E verification of JMIB universal-societal-challenge pivot (SIH26043). All 7 review scenarios pass: (1) Home hero shows 'Turning Societal Challenges Into Real-World Solutions.' with 7-step pipeline strip (Problem/AI/Right Experts/University/Industry / NGO/Solution/Impact) and both hero CTAs. (2) Explore heading 'Societal Challenge Repository' with non-health category filters visible (Water & Sanitation, Education, Environment & Waste Management, Electricity & Street Lighting); 8 seeded challenges render; search filter narrows results correctly. (3) Non-health submit (streetlights, category=Electricity & Street Lighting, Ranchi, High) yields 'Under Ministry Review' badge, then AI panel with CATEGORY=Electricity & Street Lighting, sub 'Street Lighting Outage', expertise=Electrical Engineering/Electronics/IoT/Smart City (NO Biomedical), Suggested Solution 'IoT-enabled smart lighting + fault detection', Govt Dept 'Energy Dept. / DISCOM', University Disciplines and Industry / Org Types sections all present, plus AI disclaimer. (4) /challenge/jmib-demo-water-001 university matching shows NIT Jamshedpur (96%), Birsa Agricultural University (93%), Central University of Jharkhand (93%) — RIMS Ranchi correctly NOT in top 3 for water challenge; Express Interest toggles to 'Interest expressed'. Industry section shows BuildStrong Infra / AquaFlow Water Solutions / AgroSense with TYPE pills (COMPANY / STARTUP) rendered. Offer Support dialog opens with all 5 options (funding/mentorship/prototype/technology/deployment) and confirm records offer. (5) Lifecycle timeline shows all 11 universal stages; advance-stage-button advances one stage per click with toast and disables at 'Impact Measured'. (6) Dashboard title 'Societal Innovation Command Center'; all 8 required stat cards render (total-challenges, verified-challenges, active-projects, universities, industry-partners, ngos, solutions-deployed, people-impacted) with Demo Data badges; all 4 charts (Challenges by Category bar, Innovation Lifecycle Funnel area, Partner Participation pie, District Impact bars) render; sidebar-toggle collapses/expands. (7) No browser console errors on any page. Pivot from MedTech-only to universal platform is fully implemented — non-health submissions produce non-medical categorization, expertise and university matches.
critical_code_review_comments: engine.js keyword map correctly maps streetlight/streetlighting/electric to Electricity & Street Lighting and water/drain/flood/logging to Water & Sanitation — resolveCategory works for user-typed problems.

UNIVERSITIES table correctly excludes RIMS Ranchi from Water & Sanitation categories, ensuring the water demo is matched with NIT Jamshedpur + Birsa Agricultural University (multi-disciplinary, non-medical) as required.
PARTNERS have explicit 'type' field (Company/Startup/NGO/CSR) which is rendered as an uppercase pill on each industry card next to the name.
LIFECYCLE has all 11 stages; LifecycleTimeline correctly disables advance-stage-button on final stage 'Impact Measured'.
localStorage key correctly bumped to 'jmib_challenges_v3' so previous v2 seed is replaced.

AI disclaimer copy on AIAnalysisPanel still literally says 'not medical diagnosis' — copy is fine for prototype but slightly awkward on non-health challenges (e.g. streetlights). Consider making the disclaimer generic like 'AI-assisted decision-support, not an official verdict.' Not a blocker.
seed_data_creation: Test challenge 'Broken streetlights and safety at night' created via UI submit flow (localStorage of test browser only, key jmib_challenges_v3). 8 seeded universal demo challenges auto-loaded from seed.js.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is frontend + localStorage only. Clear localStorage at test start for deterministic state. Note: section headings and industry-type pills are rendered UPPERCASE via CSS (uppercase tracking-wider / uppercase tracking-wide), so any string assertions on inner_text() must be case-insensitive or use the display casing (e.g. 'COMPANY' not 'Company', 'RECOMMENDED INDUSTRY / ORG TYPES' not 'Recommended Industry / Org Types'). Featured demo id is jmib-demo-water-001. AI disclaimer copy still mentions 'medical diagnosis' — verify if main agent updates it.
rca of the issue: N/A - no failures. Two intermediate assertion errors in my Playwright script were due to case-sensitive string checks against CSS-uppercased text; actual UI is correct.
